etymologies.etymologyHTML: From quarrel +‎ -some.

definitions.definition: Argumentative; fond of or prone to quarreling.

quote.citation: 1940, Rosetta E. Clarkson, Green Enchantments: The Magic Spell of Gardens, The Macmillan Company, page 254:
quote.text: Rampion grown in the cottage garden made the children of the house quarrelsome; breathing deeply into a handful of mint refreshed your senses, but aconite could cause your death.
